subject: Re: Streaming: responses end early with no error
body:
From: Natalie Rowe <natalie@scribehq.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 3, 2026 at 7:05 PM UTC
Subject: Streaming: responses end early with no error

Hi Ben,
Were seeing streaming responses sometimes *end early*. It looks like the stream finishes but the assistant output is cut off (we never get the rest of the tokens). No error on our side.

We attached a HAR capture of one case. request_id req_c41a...

Is there a known issue?

 Natalie


From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Rowe <natalie@scribehq.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 3, 2026 at 7:22 PM UTC
Subject: Re: Streaming: responses end early with no error

Thanks Natalie  were investigating a few streaming stability reports (stall/freeze/early termination).

Ava  can we open a support ticket so Eng can track this alongside the other streaming issues?

In the meantime: can you confirm region + whether youre using HTTP/2?


From: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Rowe <natalie@scribehq.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 4, 2026 at 1:08 AM UTC
Subject: Re: Streaming: responses end early with no error

Opened SUP-1920 for tracking. Well follow up shortly after reviewing the HAR.
